paite: Huchi in Israel chi tengteng Hebron a David kiang ah ahong pai ua, "Ngai in, na guh leh na sa ka hi uh.
heading: Judah Leh Israel Kumpipa In David Apang / (1 Kro 11.1-9; 14.1-7)
english: Then all the tribes of Israel came to David at Hebron and spoke, saying, “Behold, we are your bone and your flesh.

paite: Hun paisa in leng Saul ka tung ua kumpipa ahih lai a leng Israelte pikhia leh pilutpa na hi. TOUPA'N na kiang ah, ka mi Israelte na vak dia, Israelte tung ah heutu in na om ding, achi," achi uhi.
english: In times past, when Saul was king over us, it was you who led Israel out and in. Yahweh said to you, ‘You will be shepherd of my people Israel, and you will be prince over Israel.’”

paite: Israel upa tengteng Hebron ah kumpipa kiang ah ahoh uh. Kumpipa David in Hebron ah TOUPA ma ah amau toh thu akhung hi. Huchi in Israelte tung a kumpipa ding in David thau anilh uhi.
english: So all the elders of Israel came to the king to Hebron, and King David made a covenant with them in Hebron before Yahweh; and they anointed David king over Israel.

paite: Vai ahawm pat tung in David kum sawmthum a upa ahi a, kum sawmli sung vai ahawm hi.
english: David was thirty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned forty years.

paite: Hebron ah Judahte tung ah kum sagih leh kha guk vai ahawm a; Jerusalem ah Israelte leh Judah tengteng tung ah kum sawmthum-le-thum vai ahawm hi.
english: In Hebron he reigned over Judah seven years and six months, and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty-three years over all Israel and Judah.

paite: Kumpipa leh amite huai gam a teng Jebus mite sim ding in Jerusalem ah ahoh uhi. Huai mite'n David ahong lut theih louh gingta in, David kiang ah, "Hiai ah na hong lut het kei ding. Mittaw leh khebaite'n hon na dal ding uh," achi uhi.
english: The king and his men went to Jerusalem against the Jebusites, the inhabitants of the land, who spoke to David, saying, “The blind and the lame will keep you out of here,” thinking, “David can’t come in here.”

paite: Himahleh David in Zion kulhpi alazou a, huai tuh David khopi ahi.
english: Nevertheless David took the stronghold of Zion. This is David’s city.

paite: David in huai ni in, "Jebus mi sual peuhmahte tuiluanna ah paitou uhenla, David mudah khebai leh mittawte that uheh," achi hi. Huaiziak in ahi, "Mittaw leh khebaite inn ah ahong lut kei ding uh," achih uh.
english: David said on that day, “Whoever strikes the Jebusites, let him go up to the watercourse and strike those lame and blind, who are hated by David’s soul.” Therefore they say, “The blind and the lame can’t come into the house.”

paite: Huchi in David kulh ah ateng a, David khua achi uhi. David in Millo a pan akimvel leh asunglam ah kulh abawl hi,
english: David lived in the stronghold, and called it David’s city. David built around from Millo and inward.

paite: David in TOUPA, Sepaihte' Pathian akiang a a-om ziak in thupi lam amanoh zel hi.
english: David grew greater and greater, for Yahweh, the God of Armies, was with him.

paite: Tura kumpipa Hiram in David kiang ah mi asawl a, sidar singte akhak a, khutsiamte leh suangseksiamte asawl a, David a ding in inn alamsak uhi.
english: Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, with cedar trees, carpenters, and masons; and they built David a house.

paite: David in TOUPA'N amah Israel mite tung a kumpipa ding in akipsak a, ami Israelte ziak in alalgam atawisang chih athei hi.
english: David perceived that Yahweh had established him king over Israel, and that he had exalted his kingdom for his people Israel’s sake.

paite: David in Hebron apawtsan nung in Jerusalem a pan mei leh zi aneih behlap hi. Huchi in David in tapate leh tanute anei nawn lai hi.
english: David took more concubines and wives for himself out of Jerusalem, after he had come from Hebron; and more sons and daughters were born to David.

paite: Jerusalem a aneihte min hiaite ahi: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan leh Solomon,
english: These are the names of those who were born to him in Jerusalem: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon,

paite: Ibhar, Elishua, Nepheg leh Japhia,
english: Ibhar, Elishua, Nepheg, Japhia,

paite: Elishama, Eliada leh Eliphalet.
english: Elishama, Eliada, and Eliphelet.

paite: Himahleh Israel mite kumpipa ding in David thau anilh uh chih Philistia mite'n azak un Philistia mi tengteng David zong ding in ahohtou uh. David in ana za a, kulh sung ah apaisuk hi.
heading: Philistiate Tung A Vualzohna / (1 Kro 14.8-17)
english: When the Philistines heard that they had anointed David king over Israel, all the Philistines went up to seek David, but David heard about it and went down to the stronghold.

paite: Philistia mite Rephaim Phaizang ah akiphalh uhi.
english: Now the Philistines had come and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.

paite: David in, "Philistia mite sual ding in ka hohtou diam? Amaute ka khut ah na hon pe diam?" chi in TOUPA adong hi. TOUPA'N David kiang ah, "Hohtou in. Philistia mite na khut ah ka hon pe ngeingei ding," achi hi.
english: David inquired of Yahweh, saying, “Shall I go up against the Philistines? Will you deliver them into my hand?” Yahweh said to David, “Go up; for I will certainly deliver the Philistines into your hand.”

paite: Huchi in David Baal-perazim ah ahoh a, huai ah David in amaute asual a, "TOUPA'N ka melmate tuichin khah bang mai in ka ma ah ahon hihdalhsakta," achi hi. Huaiziak in huai mun min, "Baal-perazim," asa hi.
english: David came to Baal Perazim, and David struck them there. Then he said, “Yahweh has broken my enemies before me, like the breach of waters.” Therefore he called the name of that place Baal Perazim.

paite: Huai ah amilimte uh anusia ua, David leh amite'n ahal uhi.
english: They left their images there, and David and his men took them away.

paite: Philistia mite apaitou nawn ua, Rephaim Phaizang ah akiphalh uhi.
english: The Philistines came up yet again and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.

paite: David in TOUPA adotleh Ama'n, "Hohtou ke'n. Anunglam uah khelh inla, singtheimi kung zawn ah sual in.
english: When David inquired of Yahweh, he said, “You shall not go up. Circle around behind them, and attack them in front of the mulberry trees.

paite: Hichi ahi ding, singtheimi lek a pai husa na zakleh gamtang in. Philistia sepaihte sual ding in na ma ah TOUPA akuankheta chihna ahi," achi hi.
english: When you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the mulberry trees, then stir yourself up; for then Yahweh has gone out before you to strike the army of the Philistines.”

paite: Huchi in TOUPA'N thu apiak bang in David in ahih a; Philistia mite Geba a pan Gazer tan in asual hi.
english: David did so, as Yahweh commanded him, and struck the Philistines all the way from Geba to Gezer.
